description:
🍖 Y’all. I was NOT ready for this.

Took my team from 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐏𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐲 out to lunch and ended up finding one of the best BBQ spots in Killeen — and it’s inside the HEB on Stan Schlueter. 😭🔥

𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐞 𝐓𝐞𝐱𝐚𝐬 𝐁𝐁𝐐 completely surprised us. The meat was tender, smoky, and falling apart, and don’t even get me started on the sides. If you’re new to the 𝐊𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐞𝐧 / 𝐇𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐞𝐫 𝐇𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐬 / 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐭 𝐇𝐨𝐨𝐝 area — this is your sign to go ASAP.

Less than 10 minutes from base. No excuses. 🤠

👇 Drop a comment and tell me:
1️⃣ Have you been? What did you get?
2️⃣ What’s YOUR favorite BBQ spot around here?

Tag a friend who needs to know about this and share this with someone who just PCS’d to the area! 💙
